name: Ironband's Compound
summary: Dark Iron dwarves now hold Ironband's Compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh. Sturgy Ironband once used the camp, but its fall has brought danger to travelers and nearby settlements.

sections.title: A Fall to the Dark Irons
sections.body: Sturgy Ironband raised the camp as a staging post in Dun Morogh's snowy wilderness. Dark Iron infiltrators then pushed deep into Bronzebeard territory and seized it. Their forces now stand close to Ironforge, and the outpost threatens the city's edge.

sections.title: A Threat to Ironforge
sections.body: Within Dun Morogh, the Dark Iron camp is a grave provocation to Ironforge. The city keeps watch and sends seasoned warriors to recover fallen scouts. They also seek vital intelligence on the Dark Iron threat in the mountain kingdom.

faq.answer: Sturgy Ironband once inhabited and used the outpost. Hostile forces drove him out and seized it.
Dark Iron dwarves now control the camp. They attack wanderers and Ironforge patrols that come near.
The compound lies in eastern Dun Morogh's snowy hills, south of Helm's Bed Lake.

faq.q: Why is this camp important to the leaders of Ironforge?
faq.answer: An enemy clan has fortified a base in Dun Morogh, raising alarm over Ironforge's security. The city's authorities send fighters to gather evidence of Dark Iron infiltration.

angles.text: As a Bronzebeard, you see the Dark Irons' hold within Dun Morogh as an insult and a continuing danger to your homeland.
As a warrior, Ironforge's veteran trainers send you here to aid fallen comrades and gather proof of the Dark Iron presence.
